capabilities: Manage tasks with filters, goals, subtasks, a timer and a drag-and-drop calendar
Keep a journal of daily notes with habit, scale and number tracking and reviews
Catalogue books, movies, shows and games with ratings, progress, covers and stats
Show a dashboard with widgets for weather, countdowns, period progress and module summaries
Sync notes across devices via Dropbox, OneDrive, S3 or WebDAV, optionally encrypted
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Interface is available in English, Russian and Simplified Chinese, and a demo vault ships with each release. Weather uses the Open-Meteo API and prayer times use the Aladhan API; the plugin has no account, telemetry or server of its own.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in place that combines a dashboard, task management, daily-note journaling and media tracking in one interface.
